meta.note: Static snapshot of Mol's run-pace zones. Replace via the Garmin feed or edit in-app.

pace.name: Recover / SJ
pace.use: Recovery jogs, shake-outs, easy second runs. Pure flush.

pace.name: Easy
pace.use: Daily aerobic mileage, warm-ups and cool-downs. Conversational.

pace.name: Aerobic
pace.use: Steady aerobic / marathon-effort support runs. Strong but controlled.

pace.name: Threshold
pace.use: Cruise intervals & tempo — your engine room. Comfortably hard.

pace.name: 5K Pace
pace.use: Long reps and control intervals. Sharpening the top of the aerobic range.

pace.name: Interval
pace.use: VO2 max work — 3-5 min reps. Used sparingly to lift the ceiling.

pace.name: Repetition
pace.use: Short reps for economy, mechanics and leg speed. Full recovery.
